thread_text:
julia: CI went red on 2791234567, intermittent failure in TestMutexDeadlock in runtime/serve. Fails ~1/20 runs. Attaching last lines from the executor log I have.

julia: ```
--- FAIL: TestMutexDeadlock (0.12s)
mutex_test.go:87: timed out waiting for goroutine to release mutex
goroutine 527 [semacquire]:
sync.runtime_SemacquireMutex(0xc0000b4010, 0x0)
	/usr/local/go/src/runtime/sema.go:71 +0x47
sync.(*Mutex).lockSlow(0xc0000b4008)
	/usr/local/go/src/sync/mutex.go:138 +0xfc
```

omar: ack. I saw this crop up after the backoff refactor (PR #4287) but couldn't repro locally. Might be timing-sensitive. Can you paste the failing test command?

julia: `go test ./runtime -run TestMutexDeadlock -count=50` repros for me 2/50 with STRESS=true env and race detector off. With `-race` it crashes differently.

natalie: @julia thanks. Can you queue a CI rerun with the same seed? If CI supports seeding we should capture it.

julia: CI log shows `TEST_SEED=98342` near the top. I can't see where that gets set. Locally `TEST_SEED=98342 go test ...` reproduced once.

sam: I'll trigger a rerun and add a bisect job to try different seeds. @ci-bot can you rerun build 2791234501 with TEST_SEED=98342 and count=100?

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @sam. Queued job: runtime-test-rerun-2791234567. Applying env TEST_SEED=98342, TEST_COUNT=100. Status: queued. :white_check_mark:

li: FYI, there was a small change in mutex acquisition ordering in runner.go last month, could be related. I'll drop a quick diff comment.

li: (link) https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/compare/runner-mutex-ordering

julia: thanks — I also noticed logs show `attemptBackoff()` sleeping zero sometimes due to time truncation. Could cause tight spin.

omar: If it's due to truncation we should be able to add a tiny jitter or floor to the backoff. But first let's confirm it's not a scheduling race.

natalie: If the CI-rerun with the seed reproduces, can we get a stack dump from the failing job? Might help identify which goroutine is holding the lock.

ci-bot: runtime-test-rerun-2791234567 started on runner-gpu-12. Artifacts will be at https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/2791234567/artifacts

qa-bot: Observed 3 failures in 100 runs: seeds 98342, 120011, 98342 (duplicate). Attached simplified trace for seed 120011 showing mutex held by background refresher.

julia: copying trace snippet: ```
goroutine 302 [running]:
main.(*KVShard).refresh(0xc0002a0000)
	/home/runner/work/runtime/kv_shard.go:212 +0x2f0
main.(*KVShard).Get(0xc0002a0000, 0x...)
	/home/runner/work/runtime/kv_shard.go:89 +0x45
```

sam: ok that points to a real interleaving: refresher holds lock while Get waits. Could be a missing Unlock in an early return or an unexpected blocking call while holding the mutex.

omar: @li can you audit the refresher path for blocking syscalls? Also check deferred unlocks in that PR.

li: will do a quick pass. If someone can open a minimal repro that reproduces the sequence we can add a targeted unit test.

julia: I'm working on a small repro harness that runs the refresher + concurrent Get loop with forced scheduler yields. Will push branch `julia/mutex-repro-98342` in a bit.

natalie: once you push, ping me and I'll add an integration test that runs in CI as flaky-check with seeds.

sam: long-term fix: prefer tryLock patterns for refresher or move heavy IO out of locked region. But agree we should confirm cause first.

omar: also adding a temporary guard: if locked duration > 50ms log stack and metrics so we can catch this in staging.

ci-bot: runtime-test-rerun-2791234567 completed. Result: unstable. 3/100 failures. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/2791234567/artifacts (includes goroutine dumps).

julia: pushed branch and PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4299 — includes repro harness + initial fix attempt (move network call out of lock).

li: reviewed, left comments on deferred unlocks and a nil-check that early-returns while holding the lock. Small nits too.

natalie: great progress. @sam can you schedule a short sync tomorrow to decide between tryLock vs moving IO? 15 min should do it.

sam: yep I'll schedule 15. Pinged calendar invite to eng-runtime.

julia: thanks everyone. Will follow up with CI runs after addressing li's comments. :thumbsup:

omar: thanks — if anyone sees other flakes from the backoff refactor please drop them here.

natalie: closing loop: added flaky test annotation and linked PR to the ticket INF-214.

ci-bot: Note: tests annotated as flaky won't fail builds for next 48h pending fix.

julia: noted. I'll post a final update when tests stabilize or PR merges.

sam: end of thread.
